answers.core:
Can only be core. As both keywords if and ; are part of GDScript.

As this change breaks compatibility with GDScript 1.0 it makes sense to introduce this change together with Godot 4.0/GDScript 2.0.
answers.workaround:
It can - just write separate lines indented. 

I find it less intuitive that the semicolon acts like a line-break and so the structure/indentation is broken
which is usually followed by GDScript.

Both statements are on one line for a reason. Process both (all of them) if condition to the left is met.
